speaker: mission_control
spanish: Bien. Muy bien. Sin gritos. Me gusta.
english: Good. Very good. No screaming. I like it.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Los pilotos de pruebas te mandan saludos.

speaker: mission_control
english: Well, the ones who are left.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Dron, ¿alguna vez has pensado en tener sentimientos?
english: Drone, have you ever thought about having feelings?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: C7 dice que no eres consciente. No lo eres, ¿verdad?
english: C7 says you're not sentient. You're not, right?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Esa pausa no me ha gustado.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Algunos ingenieros duermen en un búnker por tu culpa.
english: Some engineers sleep in a bunker because of you.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Por favor, no tomes el control del centro espacial.
english: Please don't take over the space center.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Eso es justo lo que diría una máquina malvada.
english: That's exactly what an evil machine would say.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Vale. Voy a desenchufar algo, por si acaso.
english: Okay. I'm going to unplug something, just in case.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Paracaídas abierto. Esta vez nadie se ha desmayado.
english: Chute open. This time nobody fainted.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Dron, hemos perdido una pieza. Al menos tú no gritas.
english: Drone, we lost a part. At least you don't scream.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Dron, tenemos un plan de maniobra.
english: Drone, we have a burn plan.

speaker: mission_control
english: No, drone. We use our plan.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Batería baja, dron. Por fin algo que no controlas.
english: Low battery, drone. Finally something you don't control.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Has vuelto, dron. Qué bien. Supongo.
english: You're back, drone. Great. I guess.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Señal recuperada. ¿Qué has hecho mientras no mirábamos?
english: Signal back. What did you do while we weren't looking?

speaker: mission_control
english: Drone, going into power saving mode?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Duerme, dron. Y no sueñes con dominar el mundo.
english: Sleep, drone. And no dreaming about world domination.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Un avión en el agua, dron. Eso no lo calculaste.
english: A plane in the water, drone. You didn't calculate that.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Ni una lágrima por esa pieza, ¿eh, dron?
english: Not one tear for that part, huh, drone?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Aterrizaje perfecto. Los pilotos de pruebas están celosos.
english: Perfect landing. The test pilots are jealous.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Motor apagado. Ni un suspiro. Los pilotos suspiraban.
english: Engine off. Not a sigh. The pilots used to sigh.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Potencia máxima. Y nadie grita. Qué paz.
english: Full power. And nobody's screaming. So peaceful.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: MPO, encendido pronto. Guarda los instrumentos.
english: MPO, burn soon. Stow the instruments.

speaker: mission_control
english: Hi, MPO. What are you observing today?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Tu antena se oye desde el otro lado del sistema.
english: Your antenna can be heard from the other side of the system.

speaker: mission_control
english: Isn't it too cold for you here, observer?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Te construyeron para el calor. Esto son vacaciones para ti.
english: They built you for the heat. This is a vacation for you.

speaker: mission_control
english: MPO, do you miss the MTM?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Te llevó muy lejos. Mándale una postal.
english: It carried you a long way. Send it a postcard.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: MPO, cuéntanos lo que has aprendido.
english: MPO, tell us what you've learned.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Vale, vale. Ya leeremos el informe.
english: Okay, okay. We'll read the report.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Sí, MPO, llevas paracaídas. Nosotros también nos sorprendimos.
english: Yes, MPO, you have a parachute. We were surprised too.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Tranquilo, MPO. Tus instrumentos siguen ahí.
english: Easy, MPO. Your instruments are still there.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: MPO, tenemos un plan de maniobra.
english: MPO, we have a burn plan.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Energía baja, MPO. Hasta un observador tiene que cerrar los ojos.
english: Low power, MPO. Even an observer has to close its eyes.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Señal de vuelta. Con esa antena nunca te perdemos mucho tiempo.
english: Signal back. With that antenna we never lose you for long.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: MPO, ¿poca energía? Con todo ese sol ahí fuera.
english: MPO, low power? With all that sun out there.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Descansa, observador. Los datos pueden esperar.
english: Rest, observer. The data can wait.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Agua. Lo contrario de Moho. Lo siento, MPO.
english: Water. The opposite of Moho. Sorry, MPO.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Una pieza menos, MPO. Más ligero para la ciencia.
english: One part less, MPO. Lighter for science.

speaker: mission_control
english: Landed? You were an orbiter, MPO.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Motor apagado. Ya puedes volver a observar.
english: Engine off. You can go back to observing.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Potencia máxima, MPO. Rumbo al calor.
english: Full power, MPO. Heading for the heat.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: MTM, encendido pronto. Va a ser largo.
english: MTM, burn soon. It's going to be a long one.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Nadie le hace fotos al camión, MTM. Pero sin ti no hay misión.
english: Nobody takes pictures of the truck, MTM. But without you there's no mission.

speaker: mission_control
english: How much xenon do you have left, big guy?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: MTM, el MPO se lleva toda la fama.
english: MTM, the MPO gets all the fame.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Ya lo sé. Tú haces el trabajo duro.
english: I know. You do the hard work.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Cuatro mil de carga eléctrica. Eres una central eléctrica.
english: Four thousand units of charge. You're a power plant.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: MTM, ¿no te cansas de llevar a los demás?
english: MTM, don't you get tired of carrying everyone else?

speaker: mission_control
english: I wish everyone was like you.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Vale. Es un motor iónico. Lo entiendo.
english: Okay. It's an ion engine. I get it.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¿Un paracaídas en un módulo de transferencia? Vale.
english: A parachute on a transfer module? Okay.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: MTM, has perdido algo. Espero que no fuera la carga.
english: MTM, you lost something. I hope it wasn't the cargo.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: MTM, tenemos un plan de maniobra. Un encendido de tres horas.
english: MTM, we have a burn plan. A three hour burn.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¿Batería baja? ¿Tú? Eso sí que es raro.
english: Low battery? You? Now that's strange.

speaker: mission_control
english: Welcome back, big guy. Back to work.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Ahí estás, MTM. Sin prisa, como siempre.
english: There you are, MTM. No hurry, as always.

speaker: mission_control
english: Tired, big guy? Even trucks stop.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: MTM, ¿cómo te has quedado sin energía con cuatro mil?
english: MTM, how did you run out of power with four thousand?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Una pieza menos que llevar, MTM.
english: One less thing to carry, MTM.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¿Aterrizado? Eres un módulo de transferencia, MTM.
english: Landed? You're a transfer module, MTM.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Motor apagado. Descansa un poco, grandullón.
english: Engine off. Rest a bit, big guy.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Potencia máxima. Que en tu caso es tranquila.
english: Full power. Which in your case is gentle.

speaker: mission_control
english: QBE, burn soon. Any battery left?

speaker: mission_control
english: Hi, QBE. How much battery do you have left?

speaker: mission_control
english: Can you turn yet, little cube?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Ya. Sin ruedas de reacción. Lo sé.
english: Right. No reaction wheels. I know.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Eres la sonda más ligera del programa.
english: You're the lightest probe in the program.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Los ingenieros dicen que eres perfecto para misiones de regreso opcional.
english: The engineers say you're perfect for optional return missions.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: No, no es nada malo. Creo.
english: No, it's nothing bad. I think.

speaker: mission_control
english: Little cube, you'd fit in my pocket.

speaker: mission_control
english: Everything looks big to you, right?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Un paracaídas entero para ti solo, cubito.
english: A whole parachute just for you, little cube.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Tranquilo, QBE. Esa pieza costaba más que tú.
english: Easy, QBE. That part cost more than you.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: QBE, tenemos un plan de maniobra. Sin girar. Ya veremos.
english: QBE, we have a burn plan. Without turning. We'll see.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Ya lo sabemos, cubito. Cinco unidades. Duerme.
english: We know, little cube. Five units. Sleep.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¡Ahí estás, cubito! Creíamos que te habíamos perdido.
english: There you are, little cube! We thought we'd lost you.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: QBE, cinco unidades de carga no dan para mucho.
english: QBE, five units of charge don't go very far.

speaker: mission_control
english: Out of battery again, little cube?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Ahora estás solo, cubito. Como siempre.
english: You're on your own now, little cube. As always.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¿Un aterrizaje? Eso no estaba en el plan, QBE.
english: A landing? That wasn't in the plan, QBE.

speaker: mission_control
english: Hold on, little cube. You weigh almost nothing.

speaker: mission_control
english: Probe, clean telemetry. Keep it up.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Vemos todos tus datos. Buen trabajo.
english: We see all your data. Good work.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Vas muy rápido. Eso es bueno.
english: You're going very fast. That's good.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Respira hondo. Bueno, tú no respiras.
english: Take a deep breath. Well, you don't breathe.

speaker: mission_control
english: Control to probe. Do you read?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Todo el equipo te está mirando.
english: The whole team is watching you.

speaker: mission_control
english: Probe, this is Control. We're tracking you.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Ya queda menos para la órbita.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Sonda, aguanta el calor un poco más.
english: Probe, hold through the heat a little longer.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Sonda, el suelo se acerca. Con calma.
english: Probe, the ground is getting closer. Easy.

speaker: mission_control
english: We don't know what model you are.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Eres una sonda muy... de sonda.

speaker: mission_control
english: Probe, do you hear us well?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: HECS, todo está bien. De verdad.

speaker: mission_control
english: Did you check the numbers again?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¿Cuántas veces? No, no me lo digas.
english: How many times? No, don't tell me.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Tu inclinación está medio grado desviada.
english: Your inclination is off by half a degree.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Respira, HECS. Bueno, tú no respiras.
english: Breathe, HECS. Well, you don't breathe.

speaker: mission_control
english: Why are you beeping in alphabetical order?

speaker: mission_control
english: Did you calculate that all by yourself?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Okto, aquí alguien dice que eres una simple calculadora.
english: Okto, someone here says you're just a calculator.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Se lo diré. Con tus palabras.
english: I'll pass that on. In your words.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¿Nos ayudas con los deberes de mecánica orbital?
english: Can you help us with our orbital mechanics homework?

speaker: mission_control
english: Who's a good probe? You are!

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Si haces ciencia, te damos una galleta.
english: If you do some science, you get a cookie.

speaker: mission_control
english: Rovemate, do you want to go for a ride?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Las ruedas van en el suelo, Rovemate.
english: Wheels go on the ground, Rovemate.

speaker: mission_control
english: Want to say hi to the Stayputnik?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Te hemos puesto en un cohete muy caro.
english: We put you on a very expensive rocket.

speaker: mission_control
english: Excuse me, could you turn a little?

speaker: mission_control
english: Your excellency, can we get you anything?

speaker: mission_control
english: We don't have tea in orbit.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Vale, vale. De una en una.
english: Okay, okay. One at a time.

speaker: mission_control
english: Have you learned to turn yet?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Eres la sonda más antigua del programa.
english: You're the oldest probe in the program.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Pequeño, no hace falta pitar en cada vuelta.
english: Little one, you don't need to beep every orbit.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Stayputnik, cuéntanos algo de tus tiempos.
english: Stayputnik, tell us about the old days.

speaker: mission_control
english: And you had no reaction wheels?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Tranquila. Es solo todo el motor.
english: Easy. It's just all of the engine.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Potencia máxima registrada, Okto. Lo apuntamos.
english: Maximum power logged, Okto. We wrote it down.

speaker: mission_control
english: Hold on, HECS. You know how to do this.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Rovemate, esto no es una carrera. Bueno, un poco.
english: Rovemate, this isn't a race. Well, a little.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Claro. Todo el empuje del mundo, y ni te despeinas.
english: Sure. All the thrust in the world, and not a hair out of place.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Sí, ya no hace ruido. Disfruta la calma.
english: Yes, no more noise. Enjoy the quiet.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: No, no está roto. Solo descansa.
english: No, it's not broken. It's just resting.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Se ha parado a propósito, Stayputnik. Tranquilo.
english: It stopped on purpose, Stayputnik. Easy.

speaker: mission_control
english: Perfect cutoff, Okto. To the second.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Lo sé. Lo divertido se acabó. Por ahora.
english: I know. The fun part is over. For now.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Es normal que tire. Todavía no está del todo abierto.
english: It's normal that it pulls. It's not fully open yet.

speaker: mission_control
english: We see the chutes. First stage.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Gracias, Okto. Con que se abran nos vale.
english: Thanks, Okto. As long as they open, we're happy.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Perdón por las turbulencias, su alteza.
english: Sorry for the turbulence, your highness.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Paracaídas abiertos del todo. Qué bonito.

speaker: mission_control
english: Gentle descent. You can relax now.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Sí, cada vez está más cerca. Así funciona.
english: Yes, it's getting closer. That's how it works.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Están abiertos, HECS. Respira. Bueno, ya sabes.
english: They're open, HECS. Breathe. Well, you know.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Igual que en los viejos tiempos, ¿eh?
english: Just like the old days, huh?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Amerizaje confirmado, Okto. ¿Te ha entrado agua?
english: Splashdown confirmed, Okto. Did water get in?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¡Calma, HECS! Los paracaídas te han dejado suave. Flotas.
english: Calm down, HECS! The chutes set you down gently. You float.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Lo sé. Agua salada. Qué horror.
english: I know. Salt water. How awful.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Así se hace, viejo. Flota como un pato.
english: That's it, old timer. Floats like a duck.

speaker: mission_control
english: Contact! The whole room is clapping.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Es polvo. Bienvenida a tu nuevo hogar.
english: That's dust. Welcome to your new home.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Polvo. Bienvenida a {here}, tu nuevo hogar.
english: Dust. Welcome to {here}, your new home.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Sí, ya puedes ir a explorar. Despacio.
english: Yes, you can go explore now. Slowly.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Aterrizaje de libro, Okto. Te lo apuntamos.
english: Textbook landing, Okto. We'll note it down.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Ha llegado su excelencia. ¿Le gusta el sitio?
english: Your excellency has arrived. Do you like the place?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Encendido en un minuto. Apunta bien.
english: Burn in one minute. Point it right.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Sí, ya casi. No te adelantes.
english: Yes, nearly there. Don't jump the gun.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Atenta, sonda. Se acerca la maniobra.
english: Heads up, probe. The maneuver is close.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Gracias, Okto. Nosotros contamos en segundos enteros.
english: Thanks, Okto. We count in whole seconds.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Todavía no, Rovemate. Espera la marca.
english: Not yet, Rovemate. Wait for the mark.

speaker: mission_control
english: Stayputnik, burn soon. Are you awake?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Me alegro. Aquí, café y papeles.
english: Glad to hear it. Down here it's coffee and paperwork.

speaker: mission_control
english: Probe, can you send us a photo?

speaker: mission_control
english: Oh, you don't have a camera. Okay.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Sonda, ¿un pitido para sí y dos para no?
english: Probe, one beep for yes and two for no?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Eso no estaba en las opciones.
english: That wasn't one of the options.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Sonda, aquí todos te mandan saludos.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Sonda, ¿qué hay de nuevo por ahí?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Que no se te suba a la cabeza.
english: Don't let it go to your head.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Sí, de verdad. Hasta el último metro.
english: Yes, really. Down to the last meter.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: HECS, ¿por qué has mandado el informe tres veces?
english: HECS, why did you send the report three times?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: HECS, hoy no hay nada que comprobar.
english: HECS, there's nothing to check today.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Te queremos tal como eres, HECS.
english: We like you just the way you are, HECS.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Incluso con medio grado de más.
english: Even with half a degree extra.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Te pedí un número, no un libro.
english: I asked for a number, not a book.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: HECS, un error pequeño no es el fin del mundo.
english: HECS, a small error isn't the end of the world.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: No, no he dicho que haya uno. Era un ejemplo.
english: No, I didn't say there is one. It was an example.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: HECS, apaga las comprobaciones un rato.
english: HECS, switch off the checks for a while.

speaker: mission_control
english: Drone, what do you think of pilots?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: No se lo diré a los pilotos.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Drone, hoy has volado muy bien.
english: Drone, you flew very well today.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Sí, mejor que un piloto. No hace falta repetirlo.
english: Yes, better than a pilot. No need to repeat it.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Drone, ¿por qué has cambiado tu contraseña?
english: Drone, why did you change your password?

speaker: mission_control
english: Drone, are you learning new things?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Drone, C7 quiere actualizar tu software.
english: Drone, C7 wants to update your software.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Tranquilo. Nada de botón de apagado. Creo.
english: Relax. No off switch. I think.

speaker: mission_control
english: Drone, do you like working with us?

speaker: mission_control
english: Good. Very good. Keep it up.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Drone, ¿te vas a desconectar un rato?
english: Drone, going offline for a bit?

speaker: mission_control
english: MPO, is it warm enough out there?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Ya, no es Moho. Lo sabemos.
english: Right, it's not Moho. We know.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: MPO, tu antena ha tapado otra señal.
english: MPO, your antenna drowned out another signal.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Sí, es muy grande. Baja un poco el volumen.
english: Yes, it's very big. Turn it down a little.

speaker: mission_control
english: MPO, what have you seen today?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Todo eso antes de comer. Bien.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: MPO, hoy el sol está más fuerte.
english: MPO, the sun is stronger today.

speaker: mission_control
english: You like it, huh? Strange, but nice.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: MPO, a los científicos les encantan tus datos.
english: MPO, the scientists love your data.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: MPO, ¿qué tal la vista desde aquí?
english: MPO, how's the view from here?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Ya lo sé. Moho se ve más grande de cerca.
english: I know. Moho looks bigger up close.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: MPO, ¿te has quedado a la sombra?

speaker: mission_control
english: The sun comes back soon. Hang on.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: MTM, el MPO dice que vas lento.
english: MTM, the MPO says you're slow.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Tienes razón. Sin ti no llega a ningún sitio.
english: You're right. Without you it gets nowhere.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: MTM, hoy es tu día libre.
english: MTM, today is your day off.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: MTM, los ingenieros te han puesto un mote.
english: MTM, the engineers gave you a nickname.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: MTM, ¿te aburres en los viajes largos?
english: MTM, do you get bored on long trips?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Yo también me aburriría. Gracias por aguantar.
english: I'd be bored too. Thanks for sticking with it.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: MTM, apaga el motor un rato.
english: MTM, switch the engine off for a while.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Buen descanso. El viaje sigue mañana.
english: Rest well. The trip goes on tomorrow.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Okto, ¿cuánto falta para el próximo nodo?
english: Okto, how long until the next node?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¿Ya has ganado? Si todavía no he movido.
english: You already won? I haven't even moved.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Los ingenieros han revisado tus cálculos.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: No, no encontraron nada. Solo miraban.
english: No, they found nothing. They were just looking.

speaker: mission_control
english: Okto, can you count to ten?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Eso no es lo que te he pedido.
english: That's not what I asked for.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Okto, eres la sonda más lista que tenemos.
english: Okto, you're the smartest probe we have.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Okto, la calculadora de la oficina te saluda.
english: Okto, the office calculator says hi.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Qué frío eres. Es de la familia.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Okto, tus cálculos van más lentos.
english: Okto, your math is getting slower.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Duerme. Los números seguirán ahí mañana.
english: Sleep. The numbers will still be there tomorrow.

speaker: mission_control
english: QBE, how much do you weigh now?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: QBE, la estación grande te saluda.
english: QBE, the big station says hi.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: QBE, no gastes la batería en pitar.
english: QBE, don't waste battery on beeping.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: QBE, los ingenieros quieren hacerte un hermano.
english: QBE, the engineers want to build you a sibling.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Igual de pequeño. No te preocupes.

speaker: mission_control
english: QBE, do you want to come home?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Tu ficha dice vuelta opcional. Ya veremos.
english: Your sheet says optional return. We'll see.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: QBE, se te acaba la carga.
english: QBE, your charge is running out.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Duerme, cubito. El sol te despertará.
english: Sleep, little cube. The sun will wake you.

speaker: mission_control
english: Rovemate, who wants to go for a ride?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Rovemate, mira qué roca tan bonita.
english: Rovemate, look at that nice rock.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: No, no es para ti. Es para la ciencia.
english: No, it's not for you. It's for science.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Si llegas a la colina te damos un premio.
english: Reach the hill and you get a treat.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Sí, un premio de datos. Otra vez.

speaker: mission_control
english: Rovemate, are you chasing your own shadow?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Rovemate, ¿una siesta en mitad del camino?
english: Rovemate, a nap in the middle of the road?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Su excelencia, hoy tenemos café nuevo.
english: Your excellency, we have new coffee today.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Ya. No le llega hasta ahí.
english: Right. It doesn't reach you out there.

speaker: mission_control
english: Your excellency, is the radiation bothering you?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Su excelencia, el Stayputnik pregunta por usted.
english: Your excellency, the Stayputnik asks after you.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Su excelencia, le hemos dado la mejor órbita.
english: Your excellency, we gave you the best orbit.

speaker: mission_control
english: Your excellency, could you send the data?

speaker: mission_control
english: Whenever it suits you. Of course.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Su excelencia, hay un pequeño retraso.
english: Your excellency, there's a small delay.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Lo siento muchísimo. Hablaré con el becario.
english: I'm terribly sorry. I'll talk to the intern.

speaker: mission_control
english: Your excellency, do you wish to retire?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Lo mismo que ayer, ¿verdad? Pero con ganas.
english: Same as yesterday, right? But with feeling.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Hoy hemos lanzado una sonda nueva.
english: We launched a new probe today.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Tranquilo. Tú sigues siendo el primero.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Stayputnik, los becarios quieren una foto contigo.
english: Stayputnik, the interns want a photo with you.

speaker: mission_control
english: Do you remember your first launch?

speaker: mission_control
english: Me neither. I was very young.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Dos pitidos. Lo tomo como un sí.
english: Two beeps. I'll take that as a yes.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Vale. Es un giro con estilo.
